messages:
acme-sre (AcmeCorp): Hi team — after the cert rotation at ~01:10 UTC our gateways started failing TLS for inbound calls. Clients get 'certificate verify failed: unable to get local issuer certificate' and we see a cascade of 503s from the Redwood Private endpoint. Can you confirm what was rotated?

maria (Support): Sorry about that, looking now. Is that from your edge terminating TLS or from your internal service to Redwood? Any example curl/openssl output you can paste?

acme-sre (AcmeCorp): We're terminating on our HAProxy and proxying to the Redwood gateway. Sample curl error from our healthcheck: `curl: (60) SSL: certificate problem: unable to get local issuer certificate`. HAProxy stderr shows `PEM_read_bio_X509_AUX: no start line` around the same time as the rotation.

jake (Eng): That sounds like a truncated PEM chain or missing intermediate. Can you run and paste the result of: `openssl s_client -connect private-gw.acme.internal:443 -servername private-gw.acme.internal -showcerts`?

acme-sre (AcmeCorp): Pasted minimal output (we redacted other certs):
```
CONNECTED(00000003)
depth=0 CN = gateway.internal.acme
verify error:num=20:unable to get local issuer certificate
---
Certificate chain
 0 s:/CN=gateway.internal.acme
   i:/CN=Acme Intermediate CA
---
# only leaf cert shown, no intermediate PEM blocks follow
```

sre_oncall (SRE): That confirms only the leaf cert is being served; chain is incomplete. Two possibilities: 1) the rotator uploaded a bundle missing the intermediate, 2) the bundle got truncated on upload (we've seen multipart boundary bugs).

maria (Support): @jake I have the rotation id from the customer: rot-20260315-0310. Can you check the rotator upload logs and S3 object size?

jake (Eng): Fetching logs now. Found the rotation entry — upload reported 200 but Content-Length was 1536 bytes which is too small for a fullchain + leaf. The rotator client split into parts; one part terminated early due to a boundary parsing bug in the multipart uploader. The resulting object contained only the leaf cert PEM.

acme-sre (AcmeCorp): Oof. We need this fixed and a rollback — our API consumers are degraded. Can you rollback to the previous cert bundle?

maria (Support): We can roll the deployment back to the previous active cert version. Steps we will take if you approve: 1) set cert_version to prev in the private control plane, 2) trigger gateway reload (no full restart), 3) validate with `openssl s_client` and healthchecks. Approve to proceed?

acme-sre (AcmeCorp): Please proceed, yes.

infra-bot: Deployment change initiated by maria (Support): set cert_version=prev-20260308. Action: gateway reload started.

infra-bot: Gateway reload completed (status: success).

maria (Support): Rollback applied. Can you re-run your healthchecks and confirm?

acme-sre (AcmeCorp): Re-tested — handshakes succeed, healthchecks green. Thanks.

jake (Eng): Internal follow-up: created INF-9872 to fix multipart uploader and add server-side validation of uploaded PEM bundles (reject if no intermediate or mismatched key). Also adding a post-upload checksum and size check so the rotator will retry on mismatch. Planning hotfix deploy within 48 hours.

sre_oncall (SRE): Also adding an extra verification step in the rotation workflow: immediately verify `openssl s_client -showcerts` from a test endpoint in the customer's VPC (using their VPC peering or a colocated probe) to ensure fullchain served.

maria (Support): For customers running private VPCs: reminder doc note — if you have network egress restrictions blocking OCSP/CRL endpoints, stapling may fail or time out on some clients. This incident was a truncated upload, but please ensure outbound allowlists include our OCSP responders if you enable stapling. We'll add a KB checklist for rotation prechecks.

acme-sre (AcmeCorp): One more ask: can you send a short checklist we can run pre-rotation to avoid surprises?

maria (Support): Sure — I'll post a concise checklist (quick tests + commands) to this channel and attach it to your support ticket.

jake (Eng): Quick repro for our infra team: attempted to re-upload a deliberately truncated bundle and confirmed HAProxy and openssl behaviour matches customer's error. Adding unit/regression tests against the uploader now.

acme-sre (AcmeCorp): Thanks everyone, appreciate the quick rollback and follow-ups.

maria (Support): You're welcome — closing the emergency path now, will keep the ticket open for the rotator hotfix and KB addition. :white_check_mark:
